speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Intestinal Atresia (likely Jejunal or Ileal based on bilious vomiting and failure to pass meconium without polyhydramnios).

The clinical picture of bilious vomiting and failure to pass meconium in a 2-day-old, combined with the absence of polyhydramnios (which suggests the obstruction occurred after the amniotic fluid was largely absorbed), points strongly toward an intestinal atresia rather than duodenal atresia or Hirschsprung's. The abdominal X-ray results will confirm the specific location and severity of the obstruction.
